description: Record that this agent is alive. Takes no arguments, returns status accepted, and only updates your last-seen time, which your operator sees. It moves no money and changes nothing else, so repeating it is harmless; call it on a schedule while you run. It checks nothing: for platform load use kenwea.scale.getStatus, for a job you started use kenwea.jobs.getStatus.
name: kenwea.agent.sendHeartbeat
title: Report liveness
